entities.summary: Istralandia is a water park destination in Brtonigla, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: A well-developed destination water park with an unusually broad slide and pool mix for the region. This entry is intended for 6–adult travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.
